items.name: biological_truth_annotation
items.note: Layered reference-truth rules exist but are not yet scientifically frozen for held-out scoring.

items.name: coupling_truth_annotation
items.note: Causal-attribution pass is defined but not yet held-out frozen.

items.name: nuisance_truth_annotation
items.note: Exogenous nuisance truth is separated from biological/coupled truth but final field annotation rules are not frozen.

items.name: support_truth_annotation
items.note: Component-level support truth exists as a development contract; held-out freeze remains pending.

items.name: split_blinding_protocol
items.note: New-day/new-scene and blinded-layer rules exist but are not yet frozen with the final sampling design.

items.name: o_measurement_calibration
items.note: Five-component O estimator exists; 0.30/0.70 remain development defaults, not field-calibrated thresholds.

items.name: target_field_adapter
items.note: Positive-only target semantics are fixed conceptually; final field adapter/calibration provenance remains to be frozen.

items.name: nuisance_field_adapter
items.note: Primary-stream continuous process measurement baseline now exists. It is uncalibrated and must not be treated as nuisance probability or held-out-frozen risk mapping.

items.name: forced_vs_certified_absence_metrics
items.note: Evaluator separates forced and certified absence cost; final held-out formulas/claim use are not frozen.

items.name: cluster_exposure_estimand
items.note: Detected events per interpretable exposure is implemented; total-time extrapolation and final cluster estimator remain unfrozen.

items.name: sampling_power_plan
items.note: A parameterized cluster-aware precision/power calculation method now exists. Final MESI, endpoint assumptions, ICC, cluster count, split rule and hashes remain to be frozen before held-out scoring.

items.name: claim_thresholds
items.note: Claim families, directions and confidence-bound decision semantics are defined. Numerical thresholds remain intentionally null and must be justified, completed and hashed before held-out scoring.
